jobs.description:

Job Description
The TPS Strategy and Transformation Leader is responsible for spearheading the TPS strategy agenda. The leader will translate insights from external trends, competitive intelligence, and internal performance into long-range strategic choices and value pathways. Reporting directly to the TPS executive leader, this individual will serve as a strategic thought partner responsible for shaping growth priorities, transformation initiatives, investment decisions, and strategic execution across TPS. This individual acts as the primary partner in developing strategy, scenario planning, capital allocation, and enterprise prioritization, with transformation serving as the mechanism for executing strategic choices.

Key Responsibilities:
TPS Strategy Development and Cross-PMI Project Leadership
- Own and lead a portfolio of business-wide strategic projects requiring cross-PMI collaboration.
- Drive high-growth initiatives focused on increasing fee revenue and market share.
- Develop trusted partnerships with senior leaders and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
- Partner with Business Insights to conduct market and sector scans, industry trend analysis, and external benchmarking to identify disruptive forces.
- Connect the dots across businesses to deliver optimal solutions to clients.
- Lead the development of executive-level strategy narratives, deliverables, and analyses in partnership with TPS and PMI leadership. Areas of focus will include long-term value creation, strategy reviews, capital allocation, investment priorities, risk, competitive threats, and restructuring needs.
- Develop clear, insight-driven strategy narratives for executive audience
- Translate complex strategic issues and analytical findings into concise recommendations that enable executive decision-making.

Strategic Planning and Commercial Excellence
- Lead annual and multi-year strategic planning activities, including Horizon 2 and Horizon 3 planning, to ensure alignment with enterprise and PMI priorities and capital-allocation parameters.
- Manage a portfolio of strategic bets, including divestitures, new-market entry, adjacencies, and business-model innovations.
- Identify growth opportunities across market expansion, customer segmentation, value-based pricing, new-product strategy, ecosystem partnerships, and line-of-business growth.
- Develop a repeatable product-commercialization framework that supports initiatives from incubation through launch.
- Partner with senior leaders to evaluate portfolio choices and translate long-range strategy into executable priorities.

Strategic Investments
- Collaborate with the PMI CAO organization, Enterprise Strategy, Finance, Corporate Development, and business leaders to develop M&A theses, diligence frameworks, and integration strategies.
- Assess build, buy, and partner options based on strategic fit and potential synergies, partnering with Finance.
- Represent TPS in strategic discussions involving potential M&A, partnership, and bolt-on opportunities.
- Ensure the TPS operating model supports strategic priorities through effective governance, clear decision rights, and measurable KPIs.
- Use OKRs selectively to translate strategy into measurable outcomes.

Executive Partnership and Strategic Influence
- Partner with senior leaders across TPS, PMI, Enterprise Strategy, Corporate Development, and Finance to shape growth priorities, strategic investments, and transformation initiatives.
- Influence decisions and move complex initiatives forward across organizational boundaries without relying on direct reporting authority.
- Develop and refine executive communications, strategic presentations, and recommendations for senior-leadership and governance forums.
- Coach and guide analysts and junior team members supporting strategic initiatives, whether or not they report directly to this position.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills
- Twelve or more years of experience in corporate strategy, enterprise strategy, or management consulting, with experience supporting complex business and transformation agendas.
- Experience in financial services, banking, payments, fintech, or a closely related industry.
- Exceptional quantitative and analytical problem-solving skills.
- Demonstrated ability to develop executive-level narratives and communicate complex strategic recommendations clearly to senior leaders.
- Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
- Strong leadership, stakeholder-management, and influencing skills, including the ability to operate effectively without direct authority.
- Strong understanding of financial concepts, operating models, capital-allocation considerations, and industry and payments trends.
- Ability to organize and prioritize critical issues to support timely and effective decision-making.
- Experience coaching and developing junior talent, including team members who may not report directly to the position, while overseeing high-priority projects.

Preferred Skills and Experience
- Undergraduate or graduate degree in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
- Experience in corporate or enterprise strategy within a bank or other financial-services organization.
- Experience in a top-tier strategy-consulting environment.
- Experience applying data analysis to solve business problems in fast-paced environments.
- Cross-functional collaboration experience, including influencing stakeholders and working with diverse teams.
- Experience advising senior leaders on growth strategy, market entry, product launches, partnership evaluations, portfolio choices, and operating-model design.
- Experience applying structured problem-solving and design-thinking methods to strategic priorities.
- Ability to gather, analyze, and present data, including financial modeling and industry research, to senior executives.
- Experience developing strategic presentations and executive narratives for internal and external audiences.
- Experience monitoring industry trends and sharing relevant insights across teams.
- Experience collaborating across functions and businesses to deliver client-focused solutions.
- Experience shaping three- to five-year business strategies, defining growth opportunities, and identifying sources of competitive advantage.

Ideal Candidate Profile
- Twelve or more years of experience in corporate strategy, enterprise strategy, or top-tier management consulting.
- A background combining strategy experience with knowledge of banking, financial services, or payments is strongly preferred.
- Experience from a leading strategy-consulting firm is highly valued.
- Proven experience in strategy formulation, market insights, portfolio strategy, and growth strategy.
- Demonstrated ability to lead significant strategic initiatives and manage senior stakeholders in a complex, matrixed organization.
- Ability to combine rigorous analysis with clear executive storytelling and practical execution.

Outcomes and Goals
- Value Creation: Help deliver business revenue targets and establish TPS’s growth trajectory through 2030.
- Growth Acceleration: Achieve revenue uplift through portfolio focus, go-to-market excellence, and digital and AI strategies, while increasing productivity in priority functions.
- Operating Model Modernization: Establish a target operating model with clear accountabilities, decision rights, governance, and business rhythms, including product and sales reviews, strategic client reviews, and business reviews.
- Program Durability: Build an enduring transformation capability embedded in the operating rhythm and aligned with aspirational goals rather than benchmarks alone.

jobs.description:

Job Description
The Global Custody Strategy Manager will own the strategy, commercial roadmap, pricing discipline, margin management, competitive positioning, and investment priorities for U.S. Bank’s Global Custody offering. This client- and industry-facing role serves as the dedicated commercial and strategic owner for custody, creating clear accountability for revenue growth, client profitability, modernization, and scalable growth.

The role will partner closely with the Head of Custody for Asset Managers and the Product Office (CPO) on the strategy roadmap, capability development, and investment priorities, while also working across Operations, Network Management, Technology, Risk, Strategy Development, Finance, Relationship Management, and business-line leadership to define where U.S. Bank should invest, how custody capabilities should evolve, and how the strategy should be positioned across asset managers, fund sponsors, and Corporate Trust / structured finance clients.

This role will translate client needs, market trends, service issues, and financial performance into a prioritized roadmap, investment cases, pricing framework, and growth plan.

Essential Functions:

Strategy & Commercial Ownership
- Define and execute the Global Custody strategy in alignment with Global Investment Services’ strategic priorities and the emerging Custody Asset Management vertical.
- Partner with CPO on the custody strategy roadmap, including prioritization of new capabilities, service enhancements, and investment cases to improve competitiveness, client experience, scalability, and profitability.
- Establish a disciplined strategy framework covering economics, client segmentation, capability prioritization, competitive positioning, and go-to-market planning.
- Translate demand across mutual funds, ETFs, alternatives, CLOs, structured products, and asset-manager custody relationships into prioritized strategic opportunities.

Revenue, Margin & P&L Discipline
- Own the custody commercial model with Finance, including revenue growth planning, margin analysis, client profitability reporting, pricing effectiveness, and financial performance routines.
- Build revenue, margin, and client profitability dashboards to support transparent leadership decision-making.
- Evaluate custody economics, pricing models, sub-custodian costs, deposit economics, and investment prioritization across custody segments.
- Develop and maintain a pricing framework and segment strategy that supports profitable growth, commercial consistency, and competitive positioning.

Client, Market & Competitive Positioning
- Serve as the strategic subject-matter expert for Global Custody in client, prospect, consultant, and industry discussions.
- Develop competitive intelligence on peer custodians, service models, pricing approaches, investment trends, and emerging custody capabilities.
- Partner with Marketing and business leadership to develop client-facing collateral, strategic positioning, and launch materials.
- Identify cross-sell opportunities across custody-adjacent businesses, including fund services, Corporate Trust / structured finance, cash, liquidity, securities lending, and related solutions.

Strategy Roadmap, Investment Prioritization & Transformation
- Own the strategy roadmap in close partnership with the Product Office (CPO), aligning capability development and investment priorities with client needs, financial returns, operational readiness, service quality, and strategic growth objectives.
- Partner with Technology, Operations, Transformation, Network Management, Risk, and business partners to modernize custody capabilities, improve data quality, standardize workflows, and prepare for new products or regulatory change.
- Convert recurring service issues, inquiry themes, market pain points, and operational constraints into product roadmap priorities.
- Develop business cases for strategic enhancements, platform investments, market expansion, automation, and new custody capabilities.

Operating Model Partnership & Governance
- Partner with Operations, Network Management, Technology, Risk, and CAO / Business Management to align strategic decisions with service execution, operational resiliency, controls, and client-ready delivery.
- Provide strategic input into SLAs, KPIs, KRIs, issue tracking, executive scorecards, and operating forums so service performance and client feedback inform commercial prioritization.
- Establish a regular product governance rhythm with Finance, Operations, Technology, Risk, Relationship Management, and business-line leaders.
- Ensure strategic decisions support a scalable custody platform across Asset Managers and Corporate Trust / structured finance segments.

Risk, Controls & Regulatory Alignment
- Partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations, and Network Management to ensure custody strategy, pricing, market expansion, and new capabilities align with custody regulations, policies, risk appetite, and controls.
- Incorporate regulatory, market structure, settlement, tax, asset servicing, and sub-custodian considerations into roadmap decisions.
- Support strategy-level risk reviews, control assessments, and remediation planning where design, pricing, service standards, or operating model gaps create risk.

Financial Management & Resource Stewardship
- Partner with Finance and business leadership on forecasting, budgeting, investment prioritization, vendor / third-party cost analysis, and strategy-level financial planning.
- Ensure strategic investments are supported by clear business cases, expected financial outcomes, operational readiness requirements, and measurable benefits.
- Work with CAO / Business Management to align revenue, margin, investment progress, service quality, and issue themes into executive scorecards.

Specifications
This role operates in a matrixed, highly regulated financial services environment and requires frequent partnership with senior leaders, Strategy, Operations, Finance, Technology, Risk, Network Management, Relationship Management, clients, consultants, and external industry participants.
The role requires strong commercial judgment, custody expertise, financial discipline, strategy capability, and the ability to translate client needs, market trends, industry developments, and operational complexity into clear strategic priorities.

Basic Qualifications
- Management/supervisory experience
- 10 or more years of banking or other relevant experience

Preferred Qualifications
- 10+ years of progressive experience in custody, asset servicing, securities services, strategy, financial services strategy, or related institutional banking roles.
- Demonstrated understanding of global custody, including safekeeping, settlement, asset servicing, cash, tax, market access, sub-custodian networks, and client service delivery.
- Experience developing or managing custody strategy, pricing frameworks, business cases, roadmaps, financial performance routines, or commercial growth plans.
- Strong financial acumen with ability to analyze revenue, margin, profitability, pricing, cost drivers, and investment returns.
- Proven ability to lead through influence across Strategy, Operations, Technology, Risk, Finance, Relationship Management, clients, industry participants, and senior leadership stakeholders.
- Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
- MBA, or equivalent advanced credential.
- Experience at a global custodian, asset servicer, bank, or institutional platform with exposure to cross-border custody, fund services, Corporate Trust / structured finance, ETFs, alternatives, CLOs, or asset-manager segments.
- Experience partnering with Technology and Operations to modernize platforms, automate workflows, improve reporting, and scale strategic custody capabilities.
- Familiarity with emerging custody trends including digital assets, tokenization, T+1 settlement, blockchain-based recordkeeping, and regulatory evolution.

Competencies

Strategy & Commercial Ownership
- P&L, Pricing & Margin Discipline
- Client-Centric Product Design
- Client-Centric Strategy Design
- Investment Prioritization & Business Case Development
- Cross-Functional Influence & Executive Communication
- Data-Driven Decision Making
- Risk, Controls & Governance Discipline
- Operating Model & Transformation Orientation
- Financial Acumen and Commercial Judgment
- These competencies reflect the role’s focus on strategic ownership, commercial discipline, executive influence, client- and industry-facing engagement, and risk-aware execution.

Job Description
The Sales Support & Training Strategy Manager is an individual-contributor program manager within the Client Solutions Resources & Training team, with balanced responsibility for coordinating sales support and developing training strategy across Treasury and Payment Solutions. On the sales support side, the role equips sales teams with product expertise, compelling demonstrations, and practical tools that strengthen opportunities. On the training strategy side, the role assesses learning needs, recommends priorities, and implements scalable education approaches that build knowledge, readiness, and consistent execution across sales and client-facing teams.
Success is measured equally through the effectiveness of sales support and the impact of training strategy. Key indicators include seller readiness, demonstration quality, stakeholder satisfaction, learning adoption, knowledge retention, resource utilization, and contribution to stronger sales execution and client outcomes. The position has no direct reports and does not own a sales quota or product roadmap; it delivers results through subject matter expertise, program coordination, cross-functional influence, demonstrations, training solutions, and quantifiable client satisfaction.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on, consultative professional who combines sales support experience with training strategy, instructional design, presentation, facilitation, project coordination, and stakeholder management capabilities. This individual can simplify complex product capabilities, assess learning needs, tailor demonstrations and training solutions, manage work across multiple partners, and influence outcomes in a complex financial services or technology environment.

Key Responsibilities
Sales Support Strategy & Execution
- Coordinate and continuously improve sales support practices for Treasury and Payment Solutions, aligning resources, processes, and engagement approaches with sales priorities and opportunity needs.
- Partner with sales professionals to clarify opportunity context, define engagement goals, prepare product positioning, and anticipate questions or objections.
- Plan, prepare, and deliver tailored product demonstrations that clearly connect capabilities to prospect objectives and desired business outcomes.
- Provide product expertise, consultative guidance, and presentation support throughout the sales cycle.
- Maintain repeatable demonstration standards, discovery practices, presentation assets, and seller-readiness tools that improve consistency, quality, and scalability.

Training Strategy & Learning Solutions
- Develop and maintain a training strategy for Treasury and Payment Solutions that aligns learning priorities, curricula, resources, and delivery approaches with business objectives and workforce needs.
- Deliver engaging training through instructor-led sessions, live and recorded webinars, virtual learning environments, and other appropriate venues based on audience needs, content, and business objectives.
- Translate business and learner needs into structured learning journeys, curricula, role-based development plans, and targeted training solutions.
- Apply adult-learning and instructional-design principles to create effective instructor-led, virtual, self-directed, and blended learning experiences.
- Coordinate governance, prioritization, maintenance, and evaluation practices that keep training accurate, relevant, scalable, and aligned with changing products and business priorities.

Enablement, Learning Content & Product Expertise
- Create and maintain demonstration scripts, learning modules, facilitator guides, participant materials, product guides, job aids, assessments, and reinforcement resources.
- Coach sales and client-facing teams to conduct effective discovery, position solutions clearly, and apply product knowledge with confidence.
- Maintain deep working knowledge of Treasury and Payment Solutions products, including SinglePoint capabilities, client workflows, competitive positioning, adoption needs, and implementation considerations.
- Partner with Product teams on updates, launches, training-readiness activities, and modernization of demonstration and learning resources.
- Ensure sales enablement and training materials remain accurate, accessible, compliant, audience-centered, and aligned with approved positioning and instructional standards.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration
- Build strong partnerships across Sales, Product, Treasury Management, Operations, Implementation, Client Support, Marketing, and other client-facing teams.
- Work with subject matter experts to maintain accurate product knowledge and convert technical information into practical sales guidance and effective learning experiences.
- Coach and support colleagues who contribute to sales enablement, product demonstrations, instructional design, facilitation, or training delivery, without direct supervisory responsibility.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement
- Establish balanced measures for sales support effectiveness and training impact, including seller readiness, demonstration quality, stakeholder satisfaction, participation, learning adoption, knowledge retention, resource utilization, and performance improvement.
- Use sales partner feedback, learner feedback, assessment results, utilization data, and business outcomes to refine strategy, content, and delivery practices.
- Identify patterns across sales opportunities and learning needs and recommend improvements to product positioning, enablement resources, curricula, demonstrations, and cross-functional processes.
- Scale sales support and training practices while maintaining accuracy, consistency, responsiveness, instructional quality, and a strong learner experience.

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
- Eight to ten years of experience in project management activities

Preferred Skills/Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, Education, Instructional Design, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- 5+ years of experience spanning sales enablement, presales support, training strategy, instructional design, product demonstrations, facilitation, or related disciplines.
- Demonstrated experience supporting sales opportunities and developing product, role-based, or departmental training strategies.
- Ability to conduct effective discovery and learning needs assessments and translate findings into tailored demonstrations, curricula, and training solutions.
- Strong facilitation, presentation, storytelling, instructional design, project management, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and credibly.
- Ability to independently manage multiple opportunities, training initiatives, deliverables, and priorities in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
- Experience within financial services, treasury management, payments, banking, fintech, or business-to-business technology.
- Experience supporting complex sales cycles and coordinating product, role-based, or departmental learning programs.
- Knowledge of treasury management platforms, payment workflows, client onboarding, and related operational considerations.
- Experience creating scalable demonstration, sales enablement, curriculum, or blended-learning programs.
- Experience measuring sales support and training effectiveness through feedback, assessments, analytics, knowledge retention, performance indicators, and business outcomes.
- Experience coaching presenters, facilitators, sales professionals, or other client-facing colleagues through influence rather than formal supervision.

- Frame and influence enterprise trade-offs across capital, cost structure, and growth investments, serving as trusted counsel on MC- and BOD-ready decision inputs and narratives.

- Trusted decision partner to the Managing Committee, CFO, and CEO — extending influence of Corporate FP&A on enterprise and BOD matters
- Forward-looking, scenario-based decision support is consistently used to guide enterprise priorities and leadership decisions.
- Resource allocation choices are transparent, strategy-aligned, and grounded in clear trade-off analysis.
- Executive teams spend more time making decisions and less time reconciling assumptions, options, or financial implications.

- Competitive and external insight are embedded enterprise strategic choices that clearly connect strategy, financial outcomes, risks, and recommended actions.

- Deep financial analysis, enterprise FP&A, capital allocation, and resource allocation expertise.

- Strategic vision and enterprise orientation, with the judgment to balance growth, cost, risk, and balance sheet priorities.
- Proven ability to build collaborative relationships across Finance, Enterprise Strategy, business lines, and executive leadership forums.
- Strong communication and executive presence, including experience developing MC- and BOD-ready materials.
- Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and scale high-performing analytical teams.
- MBA, CFA, or equivalent advanced finance, strategy, or quantitative credentials.
- Experience spanning both strategy and finance, ideally in an enterprise or corporate finance leadership capacity.
- Experience leading capital allocation, strategic finance, or resource allocation functions at a large financial institution.

Job Description
Drive Digital Experiences Through Customer Insight

The Digital Voice of the Customer team transforms customer feedback and behavioral data into actionable insights that influence product strategy, digital experiences, and business decisions across the enterprise.
U.S. Bank is seeking a Digital Insights Program Manager to develop customer measurement programs that help teams better understand customer needs, identify growth opportunities, and prioritize initiatives with the greatest customer and business impact. You’ll partner closely with multiple business lines and cross-functional partners to develop CX measurement programs, and develop insights that inform decisions, product roadmaps and experience strategies.
This role is ideal for a strategic, analytically minded professional who enjoys solving complex problems, designing measurement strategies, and translating customer insights into meaningful action.

What You’ll Do
·       Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of Voice of the Customer measurement programs across digital channels and experiences
·       Partner with product owners, marketing technology teams, researchers, analysts and business leaders to develop measurement strategies aligned to business objectives
·       Develop reporting dashboards and insights that communicate customer satisfaction, experience drivers, behavioral signals, and performance metrics
·       Identify feedback gaps and implement measurement enhancements that enable meaningful customer insights
·       Build strong partnerships across the organization and serve as a trusted partner on customer experience measurement and digital performance
·       Ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity across analysis, reporting, and documentation
·       Analyze complex datasets to identify patterns, opportunities, risks, and drivers of customer satisfaction
·       Synthesize quantitative, qualitative and behavioral evidence into clear, actionable recommendations that influence business priorities and product roadmaps.
Why This Role Matters
·       The Digital Voice of the Customer team serves as the enterprise’s connection to customer satisfaction across digital experiences. We help teams understand how products and services perform through the eyes of the customer by measuring behavior, capturing feedback, and uncovering opportunities for improvement.
·       In this role, you’ll develop customer experience measurement strategies, drive product roadmaps, and influence business decisions by turning customer feedback into actionable insights that drive measurable results.

Basic Qualifications
·       Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
·       Five to eight years of experience in project management activities

Preferred Skills/Experience
·       Three or more years of experience in customer experience, consumer insights, analytics, consulting, or market research
·       Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills
·       Experience translating business questions into measurement frameworks and actionable insights.
·       Effective interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
·       Ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization
·       Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
·       Knowledge of behavioral analytics platforms such as Quantum Metric, Adobe Analytics or similar technologies)
·       Knowledge of analytic tools and techniques used to measure, analyze, and communicate customer satisfaction outcomes
·       Experience performing diagnostic or predictive analyses to identify key drivers, risks, and opportunity areas
·       Knowledge of customer experience tracking programs, including Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) and Net Promoter Score (NPS)
·       Experience with customer feedback platforms such as Qualtrics or a similar CX platform
·       Demonstrated ability to combine qualitative and quantitative insights to develop a comprehensive view of the customer experience
·       Strong data storytelling skills, with skills in data visualization a plus
·       Experience creating dashboards and visualizations using Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools
·       Strong presentation and data storytelling skills
